bridges.prompt: Inside the glass-walled manager's office. The Boss slides the folder across the dark wood desk and says firmly: "I'm sorry Marcus, but your position has been eliminated." Marcus's expression shifts from attentive to shock. He takes a slow breath, nods once, says quietly: "I understand." He pushes himself up from the chair with dignity and walks toward the glass door, pushing it open.

Marcus steps through the glass door into the open-plan office. He walks down the central aisle between rows of gray desks under fluorescent ceiling panels. Coworkers glance up then look away. He reaches his workstation desk, places the family photo carefully into a cardboard box, adds his coffee mug and plant. He picks up the packed box, tucks it against his chest. A coworker says softly: "Hey man... I'm sorry." Marcus nods without looking up.

Marcus walks down the central aisle carrying the cardboard box, coworkers avoiding eye contact on both sides. He reaches the glass exit doors, pushes through the revolving door with his shoulder. The light shifts from harsh fluorescent to cold gray daylight as he steps outside onto the concrete plaza. The massive glass building towers behind him. He stands alone. Other workers stream past, oblivious. His shoulders curve inward under the weight.
